title: Falling mood
note: The 1 to 5 mood self-rating slides from 4 down to 2 over about a week, late in a Mars transit. Every value is a demo parameter chosen by the team, not a medical reference. The expectations below were written before the first run, but committed together with the results (unlike fever.json, which was committed first). If any value is changed after seeing results, say so on the project page.
expected: All three methods give the same result: mood has no spaceflight adjustment and no personal baseline in our rules.
First amber about five to six days after onset, once a rating of 2 is logged.
No red: there is no critical limit for mood.
No false alerts in the healthy period.
